rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Short corner kerb at a junction with a house 8 m away.
reasons: Corner verge, little room to stop

drivers.traffic: Busy road with parked cars just east of the junction.
drivers.convention: Residential parking with 2P resident-permit signs; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Tree and scrub canopy over the kerb; shade much of the day.

best_section.where: Marmion Parade south kerb, last stretch before the Taringa Parade junction
